brand_identity.name: WladBot / Leader-OS
brand_identity.vibe: Elite, focused, 'Godmode' Command Center, premium coaching, high-performance

headings.usage: Use for Greeting, Widget titles, stat numbers, and primary CTA buttons. Do not exceed text-4xl on the dashboard.

body.usage: Use for challenge descriptions, tasks, dates, and secondary labels.

rules.primary_text_contrast: CRITICAL: In Light Mode, text ON #BFFF00 buttons must be #0A0A0A. In Dark Mode, text ON #BFFF00 must also be #0A0A0A. Do not use white text on lime green.
rules.accents: Use #BFFF00 sparingly. It should highlight progress bars, active states, and primary CTAs. It should NOT be used as a large background or full gradient.

dashboard_reorganization_strategy.goal: De-clutter the post-login experience. Make 'Daily Work' the hero. Consolidate promos.
dashboard_reorganization_strategy.layout_structure: High-Density Command Center (Bento Grid) with a Left Sidebar.

top_bar.content: Greeting ('Willkommen zurück, {Name}'), Tier Badge, Streak Days, and 'KI-Coach' button.
top_bar.design: Sticky glassmorphic header, flex row, horizontal alignment to save vertical space. Minimalist.

action_inbox_widget.content: Consolidated Promos: 1) LIVE KI Call, 2) Leader-Diagnose Sync, 3) Strategy-Call Upsell.
action_inbox_widget.design: Instead of 3 stacked full-width banners, create a single 'Aktionszentrum' (Action Center) card in the top-right of the dashboard grid, OR a sleek rotating horizontal ticker/carousel just below the header. The 'Bento Inbox' approach is preferred: A single card titled 'Deine nächsten Schritte' containing a compact, dismissible list (using Framer Motion AnimatePresence). Use neon-lime subtle accents for the 'Sync' task, minimal borders for the upsells.

hero_bento_grid.content: Daily Challenge, Tasks (Aufgaben), and Stats (AI Readiness 81, Lernfortschritt 0%, Tag 30 Meilenstein).
hero_bento_grid.design: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6). The 'Daily Challenge' and 'Lernfortschritt' take col-span-2 or 3 (dominant visual). Stats are col-span-1 summary blocks.

quote_card.design: Demote from a full-width block to a sleek, compact Bento square (col-span-1) with a soft gradient or dark card treatment and a subtle floating play button.

sidebar.content: HEUTE, WACHSTUM, Was ist neu?, Language, Dark Mode, Upgrade, Profile, Logout.
sidebar.design: Clean, 240px fixed width (desktop). Group heavily. Use Phosphor Icons. Ensure the 'Auf OS PLUS upgraden' button is styled elegantly (e.g., ghost button with lime glowing border) rather than a massive block.

cards.style: Neumorphic/Technical mix. Flat surface with a precise 1px border. NO heavy drop shadows in dark mode.
cards.hover: Hover state should subtly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and illuminate the border (border-neutral-700 dark mode / border-neutral-300 light mode).
cards.godmode_feature: For the 'Daily Challenge' card, implement the 'Tracing Beam' or subtle inner glow (inset shadow) to make it feel like the active command module.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). bg-[#BFFF00] text-[#0A0A0A] font-medium tracking-tight. Hover: bg-[#A5E600] scale-[1.02] transition-transform.
buttons.secondary: Glass or Ghost style. bg-transparent border border-neutral-800 text-white (dark mode). Hover: bg-white/5.

progress_bars.style: Ultra-thin (h-2), track: bg-neutral-800, indicator: bg-[#BFFF00] with a subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(191,255,0,0.5)].

banners.style: If banners must be used, they are 48px height maximum, inline-flex, dismissible, with a subtle left-border accent of #BFFF00 rather than full background fills.

motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up for Bento grid items (Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.1 }}).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have a visible hover state (bg color shift or border glow). Transition duration: 200ms ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.dismissing_promos: Use AnimatePresence to smoothly collapse the height of a dismissed promo/upsell to 0 before removing it from the DOM.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG check. #BFFF00 on white is inaccessible for text. Always use it as a background with black text, or as a border/icon color.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='promo-dismiss-button', data-testid='start-daily-challenge').

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT remove any existing features (Upsells, Sync, Quote, Stats). Reorganize them into the 'Action Inbox' and 'Bento Grid' to fix the 'too busy' layout.
Implement the 'Godmode' aesthetic: aggressive use of negative space (p-6/p-8 inside cards), 1px subtle borders, and #BFFF00 as the sole accent color on an otherwise monochrome (#0A0A0A) canvas.
Merge the 3 full-width banners (Event, Sync, Strategy Call) into a single compact 'Action Center' widget (a card with a stacked list) OR a minimalist top carousel.
Ensure the design works flawlessly in both dark and light modes using Tailwind dark: modifiers.
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for layout structure, and Shadcn for interactive components (dropdowns, dialogs).
Incorporate Framer Motion for smooth layout shifts when users dismiss the upsell/promos.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use proper icon libraries (lucide-react, phosphor-icons).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx (or equivalent).
